title: 护松扉 / 排青幌
subtitle: Qichun Yuan

model.line: 3 boxes stand in this compound, 3 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 含辉楼
evidence.summary: Given to Prince Yongxuan about 1773 as 含晖园, to Princess Zhuangjing in 1801, returned in 1811 as 南园, when 联辉楼 was moved here from 西爽村. Main tower two storeys of seven bays, with a riding track 撤马道 south of it and 招凉榭, a five-bay open hall, on an islet. Its gates are 环翠 and the city-style south gate with Jiaqing's plaques 护松扉 and 排青幌. North of it lie 清夏斋 and 延英论道.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 护松扉 / 排青幌.
